import numpy as np
# Find DTG max in 450-800 C range
dtg = np.gradient(y1, x)
mask = (x >= 450) & (x <= 800)
idx_max = np.argmax(dtg[mask])
x_peak = x[mask][idx_max]
y_peak = y1[mask][idx_max]
slope = dtg[mask][idx_max]
# Baseline: horizontal line at weight at 500 C
y_base = np.interp(500, x, y1)
# Extrapolated onset: intersection of tangent at peak with baseline
# Tangent equation: y - y_peak = slope * (x - x_peak)
# Set y = y_base => x_onset = x_peak + (y_base - y_peak) / slope
if abs(slope) > 1e-9:
    x_onset = x_peak + (y_base - y_peak) / slope
else:
    x_onset = x_peak
marks.append({'type': 'vline', 'x': float(x_onset), 'text': f'Onset {x_onset:.1f} °C'})
